login.title: Sign in
login.body: Sign in to your account to open your projects.

register.title: Create account
register.body: Create an account to start working on your documents.

forgot.title: Password recovery
forgot.body: Enter your e-mail and we will send a link to set a new password.

reset.title: New password
reset.body: Choose a new password for your account.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.body: You have been invited to HSE Doc Studio. Finish signing up with the invitation link.

verify.title: E-mail confirmation
verify.body: Checking the link from the e-mail and confirming your address.

firstRun.title: First run
firstRun.body: This installation is not set up yet: create an administrator, then you can invite people.

authError.title: Sign-in failed
authError.body: Signing in through the external service did not complete. Try again or sign in with a password.
